subject: Implement privacy tag filtering for Johnny capture
description:
Implement `<private>` tag filtering to exclude sensitive content from capture in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/pydantic` for validation patterns.

**Scope:**
- Create privacy filter utility
- Strip content within `<private>...</private>` tags
- Apply filter at capture layer (before storage)
- Support nested tags
- Log filtered content count (not content itself)

**Filter Behavior:**
- Input: "Password is <private>secret123</private>"
- Output: "Password is [REDACTED]"

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/privacy_filter.py (new)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/capture_handler.py (integrate)
- Claude Code plugin hooks (integrate)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Privacy filter utility created
- [ ] `<private>` content stripped
- [ ] Nested tags handled
- [ ] Filter applied at capture layer
- [ ] Filtered count logged (not content)
- [ ] Private content never reaches storage
- [ ] `dt --check` passes
- [ ] Unit tests for filter edge cases

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
